A Catholic baptismal record for Patrick Flynn or any of his siblings is the highest-quality parentage evidence available — it would name both father and mother (including mother's maiden name), which no source found so far has supplied. Patrick's mother is entirely unknown from any record examined. Schuylkill County's anthracite coal workforce in the 1840s-1850s was heavily Irish Catholic; St. Patrick's Church in Pottsville and other early parishes kept sacramental registers from this period.
